scoring_engine.method: Checked-in October 14 logic, regular season, season end 2027. Output captured before dashboard rendering.

data_quality.verification: All 15 ESPN final matchups, 30 team point totals and 334 participant identities matched Basketball-Reference. Exact minutes and basic and advanced player statistics use Basketball-Reference.
data_quality.missing_field_handling: Absent for all 334 in the source tables. The authorized engine applies its zero fallback to these C6 and C11 inputs.
data_quality.qpix_r: Regular-season named or positional FTA baseline. No rolling-20 feed supplied. Display names reconciled to engine lookup names.
data_quality.qpix_sfa: Checked-in former-team and venue data. No positive companion adjustment.
data_quality.top10_rule: More than 8 minutes. All ties at the cutoff are shown.
data_quality.bottom10_rule: All actual participants, lowest RAW first.
